title: Say, Echo, Do: Strategic Narratives and Revealed Positioning in Financial Markets
abstract: arXiv:2609.38545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine-learning signals built from financial text treat what institutions say, and what the media repeat, as evidence about value. But whoever shapes a narrative may be trading against it. We study markets with three observable voices: institutional statements (Say), media repetition (Echo) and revealed positioning (Do). We ask when words should be followed and when they should be faded. In a linear-quadratic model of an informed institution that speaks and trades before a partly credulous crowd, talking an asset down while buying it is optimal exactly when $\varphi^2<2\lambda k<\varphi$. A distribution-free identity then shows that when the observable Say-Do covariance is negative, words carry negative predictive content and should be faded. translated_title: 言、声、行：金融市场中的策略性叙事与实际持仓定位
translated_abstract: 基于金融文本构建的机器学习信号，将机构的言论以及媒体的转述视为关于价值的证据。然而，塑造叙事的主体可能正在对其进行反向交易。我们研究了包含三种可观测声音的市场：机构声明（言）、媒体转述（声）与显露的持仓（行），并探讨何时应当跟随言辞、何时应当淡化（反向对待）它们。在一个知情机构先于部分轻信的受众进行发言与交易的线性二次模型中，“唱空而买入”恰好当 $\varphi^2<2\lambda k<\varphi$ 时是最优策略。随后，一个不依赖分布假设的恒等式表明，当可观测的“言-行”协方差为负时，言辞携带负的预测内容，应当被反向对待。在度量方面，我们推导出：(i) 一个精确的因式分解后验分布，结合文章到达时间与嵌入相似度来判断哪些文章是“回声”（转述）；(ii) 一个与收益对齐的对比学习目标……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“言、声、行”三位一体框架，证明当机构言论与其实际持仓呈负协方差时，其言辞应被反向对待而非跟随，并给出了识别媒体转述文章与度量策略性叙事的精确统计方法。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that when institutional statements negatively covary with revealed positions, words should be faded rather than followed, and derives exact statistical methods for identifying media echoes and measuring strategic narratives in financial markets.
